propositions: When structured-parse exhausts OUTPUT_RETRIES in _pai_structured's prompted branch, capture the final raw reply to an opt-in local artifact directory before raising the validation error.

The llm.parse_failure_artifact_dir config key (resolved on LLMConfig via _llm_str and REBAR_LLM_PARSE_FAILURE_ARTIFACT_DIR env) defaults to None; when set to a path, one timestamped file per parse failure is written containing reply text, model id, contract name, and attempt count.
Artifact writes are best-effort and never mask the original parse error: mkdir is idempotent, I/O errors are swallowed, and the validated exception is always raised unchanged.
At most 20 artifacts per directory are retained by mtime rotation; older artifacts are evicted on write to prevent unbounded growth on unattended hosts.
Successful parses (return path) write no artifact; the key unset preserves byte-for-byte today's behavior and zero writes.
